title: Why this is special
text: This is the operating memory of a working game studio, not a pile of exports. 412,300 Slack messages, 14,820 tickets and 3,890 wiki pages show a team that planned, argued and shipped in the open for years. A player database of 39,300,000 rows and 2,840,000,000 analytics rows say there were real players behind the game. At its peak 26 people were talking in Slack in a single month. Nearly all of it predates 2025, so it is genuine human work history that is very hard to recreate.
basis: Founder-style pitch written by the AI agent after the audit, grounded only in what this run inspected. It is not a measurement and changes no count.
